title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Front Cover

A ghost crab, Ocypode quadrata, burrows on a sandy beach in northwest Florida, United States. Crabs from this site provided evidence of individual conspecific recognition, as detailed in “Recognition of Individual Conspecifics: Evidence From a 3-Chambered Test With Ghost Crab (Ocypode quadrata)” by Trent Robinson. Photo by Jeff Waldorff.
